### Five building blocks (R-ui-craft-11)

| # | Block | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Compact prompt input** | `--r-xl` rounded bar, leading AI icon, auto-resize textarea, `Enter` submit |
| 2 | **Quick-action chips** | 4 chips (Improve writing, Fix grammar, Shorter, Translate) — `min-height: 36px`, `44px` keyboard target |
| 3 | **Live streaming feedback** | `role="status" aria-live="polite"` — pulsing dot (`dot-pulse` keyframe), stage text cycles |
| 4 | **Stop / Cancel** | "Stop" secondary button, `Esc` keyboard shortcut, visible `<kbd>` badge |
| 5 | **Undo / Revert bar** | Applied state row — success icon, action label, Undo button with `⌘Z` badge, Dismiss ✕ |

---

### States & Keyboard behavior

- **Idle → Streaming:** `Enter` or submit button → shows streaming panel
- **Chip click:** fills prompt and auto-submits
- **`Escape`** while streaming → stops and returns to idle after 1.2 s
- **`⌘Z` / `Ctrl+Z`** while in applied state → triggers undo and returns to idle
- **Stop button** → halts token output, shows `[stopped]` label
- **Dismiss ✕** → returns bar to idle state
